Payment Service Documentation

Getting Started

This guide covers how to set up and run the payment service locally.

Prerequisites

Before you begin, ensure you have the following installed:

  • Go 1.22 or later
  • PostgreSQL 15+
  • Docker (optional, for containerized development)

Installation

Clone the repository and install dependencies:

git clone https://github.com/org/payment-service.git
cd payment-service
go mod download

Configuration

Copy the example configuration and update it with your local settings:

cp config.example.yaml config.yaml

The service requires a PostgreSQL connection string and API keys for downstream services.

Running the Service

Start the service in development mode:

go run ./cmd/server --config config.yaml

The service will be available at http://localhost:8080.
